messages:
ben-sales: Quick: SovereignBank needs an air-gapped POC. Requirements: signed incremental patches, no outbound calls during install, clear rollback, and key custody options. Need answers for RFQ today.

izzy-solutions: We can deliver minibundles (delta patches) or full-image swaps. Two signing flows: customer-held key (HSM) or Redwood-signed with attestation. Which do they prefer?

mark-eng: Recommend minibundles for faster patching and small transfer size. Format: chunked tar + manifest + bundle.sha256. Verify offline with: `sha256sum -c bundle.sha256 && ./verify-manifest --pubkey /opt/keys/bank.pub bundle.sig`. No network calls.

anna-sec: Security: we support customer-managed HSM/KMS keys and can provide a documented key-injection runbook. If they require FIPS validation, therell be extra onboarding. One-liner for questionnaire: "Yes 1 Redwood supports customer-managed signing keys (HSM/KMS) for offline bundle signing; see attached key-injection runbook."

ben-sales: Procurement also asked about upgrade cadence and pricing for ongoing offline support.

izzy-solutions: Suggested cadence: quarterly deltas (4/yr) + emergency hotfix SLA (48-72h). Pricing back-of-envelope: POC eng (2 wks) $30k; Signed-bundle subscription (4 deltas/yr + priority hotfixes) $20k/yr; Customer HSM integration $6k one-time.

ops-engr: Transfer ops: recommend AES-256 encrypted minibundles with envelope key delivered via sealed USB (sneakernet) or KMS-wrap. Use `rsync --partial --inplace` for large USB transfers and re-run verify after resume. Rollback = re-apply previous signed minibundle; preflight checks block incompatible reverts.

mark-eng: We will strip all telemetry from offline artifacts. Only local logs remain.

ben-sales: @deploy-bot please open a POC ticket with tags: airgap, customer-hsm, minibundles, quarterly-patches. Include minibundle spec and the one-liner.

deploy-bot: Created POC ticket SB-POC-2026-447. Assigned to mark-eng. ETA initial artifact: 5 business days.

ben-sales: Thanks team. I'll put these lines into the RFQ response and attach the runbook. If procurement requests live key escrow or additional attestation, I'll loop in legal/security. :thumbsup:
